entries.EN: Fox asked me to find a briefcase he had dropped and take it to Sidorovich. It contains some old papers that had been stolen from the army cordon. Apparently he has more important business to deal with than play courier for the trader, acts as if he doesn't give a shit anymore. He said the case was stashed behind the southern outpost's fence, near a toilet and a heap of rubbish. Man, he couldn't have found a "better" place to drop it off...

entries.EN: Hey, Marked One, there are some docs I've happened to filch from the military outpost some time ago. Would you care to take them to Sidorovich? I have dropped off the briefcase outside of the military cordon, around the side beyond the barbed wire fence. I'd do it myself but I really have to meet someone here urgently, so I cannot leave. You mind doing the legwork? It's just a simple courier job, I really don't have much time for these things anymore. The soldiers there are drunk most of the time so stay low in the grass and move slowly, the sentries won't see you approach. Oh, and the whole area is also a minefield, but if you move slowly and carefully, you'll be able to avoid the landmines. Get behind the barbed wire fence via the fallen tree over there, then move towards the compound to a pile of garbage... There's an old toilet nearby, so you won't miss the place - you'll smell it, ha-ha... Sidorovich is quite interested in those papers, so you won't regret the efforts!

entries.EN: You see, Marked One, I need some papers to be delivered to Sidorovich... The problem is, I left the briefcase near that place some time ago as I was nearly caught by the soldiers. I'd do it myself but I really have to meet someone here urgently, so I cannot leave. You mind doing the legwork? It's just a simple courier job, I really don't have much time for these things anymore. The only risk for you is the minefield on the way to the cordon so treat lightly, get behind the wire via the tree-trunk over there, then along the fence to a pile of garbage... There's an old toilet nearby, so you won't miss the place - you'll smell it, ha-ha... Sidorovich is quite interested in those papers, so you won't regret the efforts!
